scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street corner with a white van parked along the curb, surrounded by pedestrians and buildings under construction. The sky is partly cloudy with blue patches.
scene_analysis.buildings: The large building in the background has scaffolding covering its exterior walls, while the adjacent building has a more traditional façade.
scene_analysis.materials: The sidewalk is made of concrete pavers, with a few trees and bushes planted along the edge.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk, as well as a few streetlights.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The trees and bushes add a touch of greenery to the otherwise urban landscape.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted along the street, including a stop sign and a directional arrow.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: People are walking along the sidewalk, some stopping to look at the construction site.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The older building has a brick façade.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The new building has a modern design.
scene_analysis.as_student: The street is also a hub for outdoor activities, such as cycling and jogging.
